newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Light upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Light upgraded to buy.

text.p: -- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said in a report it upgraded Rio de Janeiro state power distributor Light to long-term buy from hold.

-- "The reason why we prefer to rate Light as a long-term buy is the block expected to be sold by third quarter 1997, when the BNDES will be selling a 30 percent stake which remained from the privatization auction," it said.
-- It set a year-end target price for Light at $455 per 1,000 shares, or upside of 30 percent.
-- It said Light has gone into private management and its current concession contract reduces the risks of being in country where a regulatory framework for the power sector has not yet been defined.
-- Light common shares were up 1.39 percent at 365 reais ($349).
